recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶（G-banding）部分核型圖，只顯示一對第 5 號染色體：右側箭頭指的那條明顯較短，長臂中段缺失，標示為 del(5)(q13q33)；左側為正常同源染色體，並以小箭頭標出斷點位置。
features: Partial G-banded karyotype showing a single chromosome 5 pair
Left homolog normal, with small arrows marking the q13 and q33 breakpoint regions
Right homolog (large arrow) visibly shorter with loss of mid long-arm bands
describe_en: Partial G-banded karyotype shows a chromosome 5 pair in which one homolog, indicated by the arrow, is shortened owing to an interstitial deletion of the long arm between bands q13 and q33, compared with the normal homolog on which the breakpoints are marked. The abnormality is designated del(5)(q13q33). When present as the sole abnormality, or with one additional abnormality other than -7/del(7q), in a myelodysplastic neoplasm with fewer than 5% marrow blasts, this defines MDS with low blasts and isolated del(5q), which is associated with a favorable response to lenalidomide.
